@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Ask Extras to resolve and copy folder agents (agents/<name>/AGENT.md)
+---
+## What
+
+The agent format changes from a single file `agents/<id>.md` to a folder `agents/<name>/AGENT.md`, symmetrical with skills (the user approved this on 2026-10-09). The marketplace resolver and the snapshot writer are in FoundationModelsExtras (`Sources/Marketplace`). The rule for agents is fixed there, thus Extras must change first.
+
+Send this request to the Extras session (`foundationmodelsextras-ac`) and track it here. Do not edit the Extras repo from this session.
+
+## Changes in Extras
+
+- `MarketplaceLayer.agentsDirectoryName` stays `"agents"`. Add a constant for the document name `AGENT.md`. Change the doc comment: the folder holds one folder per agent, and each folder holds `AGENT.md` and its resources.
+- `CatalogResolver.folderAgents` (`CatalogResolver.swift:453`): find each child folder of `<plugin source>/agents/` that holds a regular file `AGENT.md`. The folder name is the agent name. Do not read a deeper folder.
+- `CatalogResolver.listedAgent`: an entry of a plugin `agents` list names an agent folder, not a `.md` file.
+- No-catalog scan (`CatalogResolver.swift:539`): find `AGENT.md` folders, with the same depth and exclusion rules as the skills scan. Keep the agent scan separate from the skill scan.
+- A `.md` file directly in an `agents/` folder (the old format) gives one warning that says to move it to `agents/<id>/AGENT.md`. It does not load.
+- `SnapshotWriter.copyAgents` (`SnapshotWriter.swift:211`): copy each agent folder as a tree to `<snapshot>/agents/<name>/`, with the same policy limits as a skill folder.
+- Keep the reserved name `agents` for skills.
+- Update the tests and the docs of the Marketplace module.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- [ ] A plugin with `agents/<name>/AGENT.md` gives a snapshot with `agents/<name>/AGENT.md` and the other files of the folder.
+- [ ] A plugin `agents` list of folders works.
+- [ ] A repo with no catalog gives its `AGENT.md` folders.
+- [ ] An old `agents/<id>.md` file gives one warning and no agent.
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsExtras passes. #waits-on-extras
\ No newline at end of file
